description: JumunCheck's dish dictionary for one country: name in the requested language and locally, a short description, main ingredients, cooking method, taste levels (0–3), common allergens, diet flags, risk flags (raw, offal, alcohol, bones, shared plates) and the usual minimum number of people. Allergen and diet data describe the typical recipe only — always tell the person to confirm with the restaurant.

lang.description: Response language: ar, en, es, fr, ko, pt. Default en; text missing in that language falls back to English.

query.description: Part of a dish name in any listed language, e.g. bibimbap or 비빔.

name: jumuncheck_list_dishes
title: List JumunCheck dishes for a country
